subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: Should the current head be authorized to remove the temporary `@openclaw/qa-matrix` workspace package and its lockfile importer after Matrix ownership moves into QA Lab?
rationale: Repository policy intentionally blocks dependency-graph changes until a repository administrator or security owner verifies that the exact-head package removal is expected and safe.

options.title: Authorize the cleanup
options.body: Approve the exact current head after confirming the parent stack owns all Matrix QA runtime and package responsibilities.

options.title: Withhold authorization
options.body: Require the branch to retain or further revise the package boundary if any shipped, build, or source-checkout consumer still depends on `qa-matrix`.

recommendation.title: Authorize the cleanup
recommendation.body: Approve the exact current head after confirming the parent stack owns all Matrix QA runtime and package responsibilities.

likelyOwner.reason: The dependency guard explicitly identifies this team, alongside repository administrators, as the authorization owner for the exact-head graph change.
